item.title: Together Post-Training: frontier-grade model shaping, the way that fits you
item.description: Post-train open LLMs like Qwen, GLM and Kimi into custom models you own, with SFT or RL. You write the training loop. Together runs the hard infrastructure.

item.title: Meta Muse Spark Open is live on Together AI
item.description: Meta Muse Spark Open, Meta's open-weight model for agentic coding, is live on Together AI with a 1M-token context window on serverless and dedicated infrastructure.

item.title: Expanding our enterprise inference capacity with IBM Cloud and NVIDIA
item.description: Enterprises can now run open models at production scale on a dedicated B300 inference cluster, built by Together AI, IBM Cloud, and NVIDIA

item.title: Together Link: open models in the harness you already use. Start with one command today.
item.description: Together Link brings frontier open models like GLM 5.3 and Kimi K3 into the coding agent your team already uses, cutting model spend by over 50%.

item.title: How to train your own Jev for $17
item.description: We just launched our own Jev-like classifier, together/Tev1-4B-experimental, on top of Qwen3.5 4B on Together’s serverless platform. In this blog post we’ll show you how to fine-tune your own version!

item.title: Canary rollouts: upgrade models in production without downtime
item.description: A hard model swap exposes every user at once, and rolling back means cold-starting the old deployment under pressure. Here's how staged traffic ramps, metric gates, and automatic rollback work on dedicated inference.

item.title: How a global fintech scaled coding agent traffic with Dedicated Model Inference
item.description: Inside a global bank's shift to self-serve dedicated inference: how Together's DMI gave engineering teams direct control over scaling, models, and testing.

item.title: Migrating from closed to open source models, Together
item.description: Moving from closed to open source models can take weeks, not years. A five-stage playbook: discover, evaluate, adapt, decide, and production.

item.title: Together AI expands fine-tuning service with more models, live metrics, and finer controls
item.description: Together Fine-Tuning adds the latest open-weight models, live experiment tracking, Expert LoRA, early stopping, tokenized dataset previews, pre-flight validation, and lower training prices on selected models.

item.title: Introducing preemptible compute: the same compute, half the price
item.description: Together GPU Clusters now supports preemptible compute: the same GPU capacity at a flat 50% of the on-demand rate, with a five-minute drain window.

item.title: To Infinity and Beyond: ThunderKittens Now on NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72!
item.description: We ported ThunderKittens to NVIDIA's Vera Rubin NVL72 and rebuilt our NVFP4 GEMM around the new hardware, taking it from 42% of roofline to over 22 PFLOPS — competitive with cuBLAS and CuTe DSL. Here is what changed in the ISA and how we used it.

item.title: The Open Source AI Stack
item.description: A deep dive into the open model AI stack — model, inference, gateways and routers, harness, and tools — and how keeping each layer independent lets you swap in a new open model in minutes instead of rebuilding your workflow.
